# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jul 7, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing the Super ZK dispute game, improving documentation for chain operators and app developers, and refining CI processes. Several critical bug fixes were implemented, particularly for precompile gas handling in Kona.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Super ZK Dispute Game Enhancements and Fixes
Significant progress was made on the Super ZK dispute game, including the addition of a ZK mock verifier to `op-deployer` for easier deployment and testing ([#21571](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21571)). QA fixes were applied to the game, addressing natspec clarifications, formatting, and adding new tests without altering contract behavior ([#21615](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21615)). Furthermore, four new integration test scenarios were introduced to improve coverage around respected-type semantics, guardian blacklisting, parent/child propagation, and chain-set evolution ([#21128](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21128)).

### Kona Precompile Gas Handling Fixes
Two critical bug fixes were implemented in Kona related to precompile gas handling. One fix gracefully handles out-of-gas scenarios when precompiles overspend gas in the fpvm provider, preventing panics ([#21582](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21582)). The second fix ensures that all gas is spent when a precompile halts in the fpvm provider, aligning its behavior with `revm`'s `precompile_output_to_interpreter_result` ([#21634](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21634)).

### Documentation and CI Improvements
Documentation saw updates with new default feature guides for Flashblocks and Alt-DA modes for chain operators, defaulting to op-reth ([#21145](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21145)). A new getting-started tutorial was added for app developers, guiding them on deploying contracts to OP Sepolia ([#21607](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21607)). CI processes were refined by running Go fuzz jobs as seed-only checks ([#21547](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21547)) and extracting CircleCI workflow routing into a dedicated script for better organization ([#21579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21579)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#21640](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21640) kona-host: Clarify handling of precompile status.
- [#21639](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21639) ci: retire Go fuzz CI jobs
- [#21638](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21638) Remove unused SystemConfig batch inbox getter
- [#21637](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21637) fix(op-node): drop stale light sequencer builds after follow reset
- [#21633](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21633) op-deployer: activate Karst at genesis by default
- [#21630](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21630) fix(kona-node): align metrics version with CLI build version
- [#21629](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21629) ci: remove orphaned rust nightly bump job

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Super ZK Dispute Game Readiness
Several issues related to the Super ZK Dispute Game were closed, indicating its readiness. This includes the implementation and testing of migration paths for isolated chains via `OPCMv2.upgrade()` ([#20758](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20758)), integration tests and deployment scripts for the super-root ZKDG ([#20761](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20761)), and a comprehensive quality assurance review on all components of the `SuperZKDG` ([#21603](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21603)).

### Karst Hard Fork Gas Issue Resolution
The issue where Optimism Sepolia's intrinsic gas was too high after the Karst hard fork has been resolved ([#21457](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21457)). The fix was merged and included in the `op-reth/v2.3.3` release.

### Op-Geth Decoupling Progress
Progress was made on the `opgeth-decoupling` initiative, specifically addressing the swapping of `eip1559`, `superchain`, and `fees` imports, and the deletion of `op-service/superutil` ([#20271](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20271)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Flaky Test Identification
A flaky test, `TestSupernodeLightSequencerInteropInvalidMessageReplacement`, has been identified ([#21635](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21635)). This test intermittently fails in CI, indicating a potential race condition or timing sensitivity in the light sequencer's operation.

### Fuzzing Strategy Re-evaluation
A new issue has been opened to re-evaluate the fuzzing strategy, specifically whether to re-enable or retire existing fuzzing jobs ([#21636](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21636)). This follows a previous change to run Go fuzz jobs as seed-only checks.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth: update revm dependency to 2.4.0 / 2.3.1 ([#21524](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21524))
The task to update the `op-reth` dependency to `revm` 2.4.0 or 2.3.1 remains active. The latest comment indicates that the new `revm` release is not yet available, and the team is monitoring its release to proceed with the update. The issue is assigned to @joshklop.
